displayName: Starter Worn Gear Family (first-hour held equipment)
gameplayRole: The six modelled held items the first hour actually uses: bronze hatchet (chop), bronze pickaxe (mine), bronze sword and forged bronze dagger (melee), worn shortbow (ranged trial), wooden shield (block); plus the bronze helm head slot

reference.provenance: Original Crafted Realm concept generated with Gemini / Nano Banana 2 on 2026-07-16

visibleFeatures: bearded forged hatchet head with proud brighter bit, poll cap, eye wedge, and leather collar on a curved two-segment haft
crescent forged pickaxe head with two worn brighter points and a visible eye block
fullered bronze sword with drooped knobbed crossguard, four alternating leather grip bands, and a faceted pommel
leaf-bladed dagger with raised midrib, honed tip, cross-wrapped grip, and disc pommel
worn single-stave shortbow: eight tapering faceted limb segments, nocks, string, grip wraps, and one off-center repair band
round shield of five arc-fitted planks in three wood tones, fourteen riveted iron rim segments, faceted boss on a riveted ring, real back handle and cross brace
forged bronze helm: faceted two-stage dome with crown button, dark riveted brow band, tapered nasal bar, hand-drawn cheek guards, rear neck flare
pivot: each gear_* group origin is its grip point; blade/business axis along game +Y, hatchet/pickaxe edge toward +X, shield face normal +X
facing: authored to the same conventions as the procedural world_gear.js builders so holdWeapon and the GLB-avatar GearFit consume them unchanged

placement.rule: src/gear_models_v1.js wraps gearMesh(id); MODEL_MAP axe/pick/sword/bow/shield plus ID_MAP bronze_dagger; procedural fallback for everything else

interactionOwner: existing animation contract: swing(player, slash/stab/crush), gather swings for chop/mine, holdWeapon grip, GearFit bone attachment

integration.tierRecolor: METALS[tier] onto CR_GEAR_METAL*, cached per material+tier
integration.fallback: procedural gearMesh preserved for unmapped models and any load failure
